data.narrative:
Seneca is a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $60M to date. The comp universe consists of eight private peers in the broader sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow stage and subsector.

Valuation was triangulated using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $60M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, implying a post-Series A valuation of $120M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable: while seven same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold for a sufficiently narrow comparable set (zero same-stage, one adjacent-stage, zero similar-tier datapoints), and using an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of autonomous systems markets.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M to $138M, with a median point of $120M. This range reflects reasonable downside and upside scenarios around the stage-progression estimate, though material uncertainty persists due to reliance on a single method. Key unknowns include unit economics, revenue trajectory, and competitive positioning—data gaps that would warrant tightening once additional financial and market metrics become available.
